title: ai-cost-meter price dataset
description: List prices of LLM API models in USD per million tokens, each read from the provider's own pricing page.

updated.description: Date the dataset as a whole was last re-verified.

rateFields.description: The per-token rates of one price block. Fields a page does not list are left out.

output_per_mtok.description: Output tokens, including reasoning or thinking tokens.

cached_input_per_mtok.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache (Anthropic: the 5-minute cache).

cache_write_1h_per_mtok.description: Input tokens written to Anthropic's 1-hour prompt cache.

audio_input_per_mtok.description: Uncached audio input tokens, when the page prices audio separately.

cached_audio_input_per_mtok.description: Cached audio input tokens, when the page prices them separately.

tier.description: Rates that replace the block's rates when the prompt has more than above_input_tokens input tokens (cached and cache-write tokens included).

block.description: A complete set of rates: base rates plus optional prompt-length tiers.

change.description: A price change the page announces in advance. From effective_from (UTC) on, this block replaces the entry's rates, tiers and batch block.

model.description: The exact model ID used in API calls.

aliases.description: Other exact IDs the provider documents for the same model.

batch_discount.description: Fraction taken off every rate for batch requests, when the page states one flat discount (0.5 = 50% off).

batch.description: Batch rates exactly as the page lists them, when it lists them per model.

changes.description: Announced future prices, in date order.

notes.description: Qualifications the page puts on these prices.

source.description: The official pricing page the entry was read from.

checked.description: Date the entry was last verified against its source.
